data: {"type":"agent_chunk","agent":"synthesizer","content":"## How CRISPR Works

Cas9, a protein, cuts DNA at a location identified by a guide RNA, which binds to the target DNA [1]. In nature, the CRISPR-Cas system protects bacteria from invading viruses [2], and this defensive role is the origin of the editing tool.

## Applications

- **Gene knockout:** Scientists commonly use CRISPR to "knock out" a gene by breaking it [3].
- **Mutation correction:** CRISPR can replace a disease-causing mutation by supplying a healthy DNA repair template [3].
- **Large-scale DNA transfer:** CRISPR SWAPnDROP extends genome editing to DNA transfer between bacterial species, shown in *E. coli* [4].

## Limitations and Gaps

The research does not cover off-target cuts, repair efficiency, or delivery barriers, so the mutation-correction application may be less established than the summary suggests. The mutation-correction claim and the SWAPnDROP result each rest on a single source and need corroboration. The research also does not describe current clinical status as of November 2026, so it cannot show how far correction applications have progressed.

### Sources

1. [Mechanism and Applications of CRISPR/Cas-9-Mediated Genome Editing](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC8388126) - Web, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
2. [CRISPR as a strong gene editing tool](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5319660) - Web, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov
3. [What is CRISPR? - Innovative Genomics Institute (IGI)](https://innovativegenomics.org/what-is-crispr) - Web, innovativegenomics.org
4. [CRISPR SWAPnDROP -- A multifunctional system for genome editing and large-scale interspecies gene transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2111.11880) - arXiv, preprint, Nov 2021
5. [CRISPR gene-editing breakthrough opens door to treating broad array of diseases](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=27643517) - Hacker News, 600 points, 234 comments, Jun 2021
6. [HIV in cell culture can be completely eliminated using CRISPR-Cas gene editing (pdf)](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=39761283) - Hacker News, 324 points, 77 comments, Mar 2024
7. [CRISPR gene editing](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/CRISPR_gene_editing) - Wikipedia
"}
